fullContentHtml:
Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Indian Navy has released the Result for the post of Navy Agniveer SSR | MR 01/2027 & 02/2027 Batch. Applications for the Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 14 March 2026 to 06 April 2026. Candidates can now check and download their Indian Navy Agniveer SSR/ MR Result 2026 from the link given below.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the Result link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout for future reference.
